boundaries.overall_goal: ACTIVE: legal ClickHouse-compatible read/write types and MV/projection coverage before memory/performance.
boundaries.finite_fixture: Eight rows, four real marks [2,2,2,2] and one physical zero-row mrk2 EOF tuple; pk plus JSON(max_dynamic_paths=0), quiescent Wide/LZ4/plain-mrk2. Retained stock s1 has UInt8 pk; fresh stock s0 and generated roles have UInt64 pk.
boundaries.composition: Reuse recursive descriptor/value/bulk traversal; typed child Object bindings and narrow layout/context owners compose MAP/Copy envelopes and ordinary advanced per-path Data, zero-occurrence callbacks, inherited profiles and containing-frame coordinates. No serializer per wrapper product.
boundaries.selected_path_oracle: Actual selected-path descriptors/caps and logical values are independently compared with captured native queries. The unhinted outer Dynamic(max_types=254) carrier alone is projected once to the SQL default-cap32 wrapper. Inner child types are never normalized by this carrier projection.
boundaries.unclosed_type_oracle: Stock nested Dynamic actual child types within Array(JSON) are not independently cross-checked against native SQL or a separate physical descriptor parser. Stock helper v Int64 and generated prepared v UInt8 witnesses are not a complete independent nested type-tree oracle.
retained_guards: Default borrowed-value entry points retain existing admission guards.
Prepared JSON-bearing Dynamic actuals reject nested Dynamic sites and require every JSON leaf binding exactly once.
Prepared child Object plans with further root or typed JSON-bound Dynamic sites remain rejected.
Illegal ClickHouse type trees are not implementation gaps.
exclusions: No Compact MergeTree part qualification; inline nested Compact callback topology is not Compact part admission.
No arbitrary new serialization versions, live freshness, complete stock nested Dynamic child-type oracle, general multi-column publication or MV/projection execution/writing.
No whole-suite or Crystal compiler-fix claim.
No performance, memory/RSS, allocator or <=10% slowdown claim.
No remote push or history rewrite.
Broad facade/writer decomposition remains open; new JSON owners have separate class files, but the legacy WidePartWriter facade is not fully decomposed.
boundaries.resource_boundary: One guarded resource job at a time, native one thread/512 MiB/10s plus 2s grace; all existing shared codec depth/byte/element budgets remain in force.
boundaries.residual_resource_risk: Per-mark transport can repeat indexing/paired-stream decoding and conservatively exhaust consumptive budgets on large parts.
boundaries.evidence_boundary: Captured artifacts, file copies, invocation records, exact SQL and output joins are authenticated for consistency. This is not immutable cryptographic execution provenance; coordinated replacement of all witnesses is outside the certificate.
